title: Clunky
text: Clunky. Keeps heat away, but not comfortable to use

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart Silicone Oven Mitts, 2 Pack - Heat Resistant to 500 Degrees - Handle Hot Kitchen Items Safely - Non-Slip Silicone Grip Oven Gloves with Insulated Deep Pockets and Hanging Loop -Green
features: HEAT PROOF OVEN MITTS – This set of 2 glove-shaped silicone oven mitts for cooking are heat resistant up to 500 degrees F. Protect your fingers to your forearms when you handle hot kitchenware items
A KITCHEN ESSENTIAL FOR HOME COOKS / BAKERS – Removing a cake from the oven? Or a pan, pot or skillet from the stove top? This Cuisinart high heat oven mitt set is a must!

PROTECT YOUR HANDS AND ARMS – Each oven glove is lined with super soft cotton and premium insulated filling to protect your hands, arms and fingers from heat, steam, and grease. No more worries or risk of burning your skin

NON-SLIP RIBBED GRIP – These kitchen pot holders are made with flexible silicone so you get a secure grip on your cookware items. Each mitt can be used on your left or right hand, ideal for when you’re in a rush
CONVENIENT AND EASY-CARE – Stains are inevitable. When needed, simply hand wash and lay flat to dry. Includes a metal hanging loop for convenience, or store in a drawer
description: Imagine the aroma in your home from a delicious pie baking in the oven. The oven timer beeps and the pie has turned a glowing, golden brown. It’s ready. Take all the stress of removing the hot pie dish from the scorching oven with these Cuisinart Oven Mitts / Gloves.Insert your hands into the cotton lined deep gloves and grasp the hot dish with the flexible silicone that is heat resistant to 500 degrees Fahrenheit. The premium polyester filling provides pure protection and safe insulation from hot items. This oven mitt set allow you to get a secure hold on the cookware you are carrying, so there’s no risk of dropping your delicious pie. Meanwhile, the deep pockets point your hands away from the hot item so as to reduce the risk of any hot steam or grease contacting your skin. These oven gloves are great for added protection to your forearms.This pack of 2 Oven Mitts are ideal for holding pasta dishes, pots, plates, bowls and so much more. They allow you to grip a variety kitchen items and utensils of different sizes to protect your hands from extreme temperatures. We also find them useful for opening hard-to-open jar lids because of the ripped silicone texture that grips so well. They are designed to suit many décor styles and can be stored neatly in a drawer or hung using the handy sewn-in hanging tab with metal loop. The mitts are easy care – hand wash and lay flat to dry.Cuisinart – savor the good life. Cuisinart luxury performance kitchen textiles offer a new level of quality, durability and style.
